parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and the response. Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.

>  You can call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)operation to query the UUIDs of playbooks.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sophonsoar describe-component-playbook --playbook-uuid ac343acc-1a61-4084-9a1cxxxxx --lang zh --api-version 2022-07-28 --region cn-hangzhou
